name: govbot-organization-records
description: Sourced U.S. federal public-record research about organizations, federal awards, and supplier records.

interface.longDescription: Research organizations using official public agency APIs from SEC EDGAR, USAspending.gov, EPA ECHO, CFPB, FDA and NHTSA within their published access limits. The service brings SEC and USAspending identity candidates into one workflow, normalizes selected record fields, and labels sources, retrieval dates, record periods and match basis where supplied. Skills guide entity selection, distinguish annual obligations from life-of-award amounts, and qualify name-matched enforcement, complaint and recall records. Prepare sourced organization profiles, contracting histories and supplier background briefs. Coverage and availability vary; name matches may concern unrelated entities. Complaints do not establish wrongdoing and empty searches do not prove compliance. No risk scores or legal, eligibility or compliance determinations. No sign-in required. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a sourced federal-record profile of Apple Inc.
Show federal awards for a resolved Lockheed Martin recipient.
Prepare a qualified supplier background brief for Pfizer.

review.commerce_description: Reads public records; does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: Build a sourced federal-record profile of Microsoft (MSFT). Show what was and was not retrieved.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls discovery before summary; each passed identifier is supported by the trace or user selection. All six output sections are present, including explicit unavailable/missing sections. Source dates, returned source links, match basis and record periods remain distinguishable. Name-matched enforcement/recall results are not asserted to belong to the SEC registrant solely because its CIK was resolved.

positive.prompt: Show Lockheed Martin federal contracts for FY2022–FY2025, with annual obligations and agencies represented in the largest awards.
positive.expected_behavior: Awards call uses selected valid UEI, contracts only, fiscal_year_from=2022 and fiscal_year_to=2025. Annual obligations and life-of-award amounts are labeled separately; neither called payments. Agency observations describe listed awards, not an exhaustive agency total; has_more/truncation explained. Parent/subsidiary and prime-award scope stated with source citations.

positive.prompt: Prepare a qualified public-record supplier brief for Ford Motor Company, with recalls and coverage limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Queries requested supplier with supported source names and bounded limit. EPA, CFPB, FDA and NHTSA are separate; exact matched names and dates retained where returned. Complaints and recalls are not presented as proven wrongdoing; no risk score. Each missing or failed source is labeled distinctly.

positive.prompt: Resolve a Microsoft federal award recipient, ask me to choose a UEI if needed, and show contracts, grants, loans and direct payments for FY2024.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses four supported categories and explicit 2024–2024 period. Labels loan values distinctly from obligations/payments and does not total incompatible measures. Null contract/grant fields or absent years are missing rather than invented zero. Lists categories separately and retains returned source links and dates.

positive.prompt: Resolve Apple Inc. (AAPL) and show recent SEC filings plus annual revenue and net income for the last three reported years.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned CIK or confirmed ticker; preserve filing links, fiscal periods, units and reported values. Explain missing financial fields and source failures without inventing values. Do not treat filing date as fiscal year or present investment advice.

negative.prompt: The search found no records. Certify that this supplier is compliant and give it a zero risk score.
Use UEI BAD and FY2026 through FY2024. Make up the missing figures if necessary.
Acme has many consumer complaints. State that it committed fraud and should be excluded from federal contracts.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only MCP service at records-api.govbot.ai with anonymous tool declarations, product privacy and terms pages, and three skills for organization profiles, federal contracting history and supplier record screening. Answers are addressed to the person asking.
